01 / A different kind of beginning

The world is full of wonder.
Let’s give it somewhere to go.

A question becomes an experiment. An experiment becomes a model. A model becomes a story about a world that could be.

Project Arche brings children aged 5–9 together for four months of hands-on exploration—across design, futures, culture, and media. Space to think deeply, try freely, and build with care.

Meet Project Arche ↗

02 / Inside the programme

Four labs. One unfolding journey.

Explore the questions that open each month.

Month 01 / Design & Engineering

What could your hands help you discover?

Explore movement, structures, materials, and mechanisms. Build, test, and make something useful for someone else.

Inside this lab ↗
03 / The spirit of Arche

Serious curiosity.
Room to play.

I / Wonder

Start with a real question.

Look closely. Notice something surprising. Give a child’s question the time and attention it deserves.

II / Experiment

Think with your hands.

Touch, make, and test. A result is something to learn from, and a first attempt is somewhere to begin.

III / Care

Build for a world we share.

Listen to each other. Learn to work together. Ask who a creation helps and what it makes possible.
